policy: Human review of the photo each product actually shows, applied after the automatic classification in src/lib/media-verification.ts. 'withhold' shows no image (the photo is of something else); 'family' stops a photo of a whole system or kit from being presented as this component alone. Remove an entry once the photo mapping in exact-media.json is corrected.
